description: The chart illustrates the distribution of sample counts across four categories: Argumentative, Narrative, Descriptive, and Expository, with a comparison between Open and Constrained sets. The categories are listed on the horizontal axis, while the vertical axis represents the Sample Count, ranging from 0 to 120 in increments of 20. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with the Open set denoted by blue bars and the Constrained set denoted by pink bars. The Argumentative category has an Open count of 79 and a Constrained count of 122, the Narrative category has counts of 80 and 87, the Descriptive category has counts of 68 and 100, and the Expository category has counts of 62 and 130. The bars are grouped by category, with the Open and Constrained sets appearing side by side for each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
